info.name: Forem API V1 agent_sessions tags API

items.docs: This endpoint allows the client to retrieve a list of the tags they follow.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size (the number of items to return per page). The default maximum value can be overridden by "API_PER_PAGE_MAX" environment variable.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows the client to retrieve a list of tags that can be used to tag articles.

It will return tags ordered by popularity.

It supports pagination, each page will contain 10 tags by default.
